description: This file contains the implementation of a builder class for configuring DynamoDB grain storage provider within the Orleans hosting framework. It sets up storage options from a configuration section and registers the provider with the hosting silo.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorageProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class implementing IProviderBuilder to configure DynamoDB grain storage options on an ISiloBuilder.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures DynamoDB grain storage options for the silo builder using the provided configuration section.
